slides.works_in: White decks that want to be left alone
slides.hook: Four mana in white that draws cards while you sit there doing nothing.

reasons.text: White's oldest problem is card draw. This is an engine that fires while you do nothing.
It only triggers when two or more creatures come at you or your planeswalkers. People notice and go elsewhere.
Second trigger is free value. Anyone casting a second spell in a turn hands you a card.

slides.watch_out: One big attacker doesn't trigger it. Mangara rewards you against crowds, not single threats.

slides.question: What does your white deck actually do for card draw?
